    Local login¶

    rn_forge.auth.local ¶

    Local password and development login providers.

    Both are :class:~rn_forge.auth.identity.IdentityProvider implementations over :class:~rn_forge.auth.identity.LoginRequest and need no extra. A failed login raises :class:~rn_forge.auth.flow.LoginFailed with code login_failed.

    DevelopmentAccount(subject, email=None, name=None, groups=frozenset(), attributes=dict[str, Any]()) dataclass ¶

    A fixture account the development provider offers.

    Attributes:

    Name Type Description
    subject str

    The stable subject; also the value of the account parameter that selects the account.
    email str | None

    Email address.
    name str | None

    Display name, also the link text when set.
    groups frozenset[str]

    Group names.
    attributes Mapping[str, Any]

    Other mapped claims.

    DevelopmentIdentityProvider(accounts, *, debug, id='development') ¶

    Bases: IdentityProvider[LoginRequest]

    Sign in as a fixture account; for local development only.

    Construction fails unless debug is true. :meth:render_accounts produces this markup, with every value HTML-escaped::

    <ul data-rn-forge-dev-accounts>
<li><a href="LOGIN_URL?account=SUBJECT" data-account="SUBJECT">LABEL</a></li>
</ul>

    ? becomes & when LOGIN_URL already has a query string. LABEL is the account's name, or its subject when it has none. The identity carries issuer "development" and amr of {"dev"}. :meth:complete reads the account form field, falling back to the account query parameter.

    Attributes:

    Name Type Description
    id

    The configured provider ID.
    kind ProviderKind

    Always "development".

    Raises:

    Type Description
    DevelopmentModeRequired

    debug is not true.

    begin(request, *, return_to) ¶

    Return a transaction with no redirect.

    complete(request, transaction) ¶

    Sign in as the account named by the account parameter.

    Raises:

    Type Description
    LoginFailed

    The parameter is missing or names no fixture account.

    logout_redirect(session, *, post_logout_redirect) ¶

    Return None; logout is local only.

    render_accounts(*, login_url) ¶

    Return the account list, each link pointing at login_url.

    DevelopmentModeRequired ¶

    Bases: RuntimeError

    The development provider was constructed without declaring debug mode.

    PasswordIdentityProvider(verifier, *, id='password') ¶

    Bases: IdentityProvider[LoginRequest]

    Username and password login against an application-supplied verifier.

    The login is a form, so :meth:begin returns no redirect. Rate limiting belongs to the framework binding. The password is never logged or kept.

    Attributes:

    Name Type Description
    id

    The configured provider ID.
    kind ProviderKind

    Always "password".

    begin(request, *, return_to) ¶

    Return a transaction with no redirect.

    complete(request, transaction) ¶

    Verify the username and password form fields.

    Returns:

    Type Description
    ExternalIdentity

    An identity with issuer "local" and amr of {"pwd"}.

    Raises:

    Type Description
    LoginFailed

    The fields are missing, the account is unknown or the password is wrong.

    logout_redirect(session, *, post_logout_redirect) ¶

    Return None; logout is local only.

    PasswordVerifier ¶

    Bases: Protocol

    Checks a username and password against the application's accounts.

    __call__(username, password) ¶

    Return the account's stable subject, or None when the account is unknown or the password is wrong.
